 Gas Cylinder E-KYC Last Date: How To Do LPG Biometric Aadhaar Authentication Of Indane Gas, HP Gas, Bharat Gas
 Personal Finance oi-Pooja Jaiswar By Pooja Jaiswar 
 Updated: Tuesday, August 11, 2026, 17:43 [IST]
 Add as a preferred source on Google The deadline to do your Aadhaar-based face authentication for Indane Gas, HP Gas, and Bharat Gas is just five days away. The government made it mandatory for non-PMUY customers to complete their LPG biometric Aadhaar authentication, which is simply called the Aadhaar-based e-KYC process. The aim is to develop transparency, tackle black marketing, and ensure genuine customers are receiving their LPG cylinders. Indian Oil has asked customers to complete their eKYC before August 16 for uninterrupted LPG services.
 This means there are only five days more left to complete your e-KYC, or else you might be bound to pay for your LPG cylinders at a commercial rate, which is above Rs 2,000 across cities in India.
 Gas Cylinder e-KYC Deadline:
 Many customers are receiving SMS messages from their LPG operators to complete their e-KYC. Millions are yet to fulfill Aadhaar-biometric authentication despite the rule becoming mandatory since March 2026.
 Indian Oil's message read, "Dear customer, you are required to do e-KYC for receiving LPG cylinder at domestic rates. Despite earlier reminders, you have not done your e-KYC so far. You can do e-KYC at your home through the IndianOil ONE App or at your distributor or through the delivery personnel. Failure to do e-KYC by August 16, 2026, would make you ineligible for cylinders at domestic rates till e-KYC is completed. Kindly complete your e-KYC at the earliest."
 On August 11, Indian Oil said, "Complete your Biometric Aadhaar Authentication (eKYC) today for a seamless LPG experience!," adding, "Use the IndianOil ONE App or get it done through delivery personnel during LPG cylinder delivery or visit your Indane Distributor."
 Complete your Biometric Aadhaar Authentication (eKYC) today for a seamless LPG experience!
Use the IndianOil ONE App or get it done through delivery personnel during LPG cylinder delivery or visit your Indane Distributor.
Its quick, secure, and absolutely free. #Indane … pic.twitter.com/QuBj3DQ76Y 
— Indian Oil Corp Ltd (@IndianOilcl) August 11, 2026 '> 
 Failure To Complete E-KYC Of LPG Cylinders? Know The Impact
 If you missed the deadline, the Indian Oil message itself explains that customers will not be able to buy LPG at the domestic rates till e-KYC is completed.
 Some reports quoted experts saying the impact would be that customers would have to buy LPG cylinders at the commercial rates. A report said BPCL would also temporarily suspend LPG connections until e-KYC is completed of Bharat Gas cylinders.
 The LPG connection will not be cancelled but will be temporarily inactive until e-KYC is completed. And you may have to pay commercial rates for an LPG cylinder.
 To put in perspective, for August 2026, domestic LPG gas cylinders, which are 14.2 Kg in size, are priced at Rs Rs 942 in Delhi, Rs 968 in Kolkata, Rs 941.50 in Mumbai, and Rs 957.50 per cylinder in Chennai.
 The commercial LPG rates stand at Rs 2,738 in Delhi, at Rs 2,691.50 in Mumbai, at Rs 2,872.50 in Kolkata and at Rs 2,906 in Chennai. In some cities, a commercial LPG cylinder is above Rs 3,000 mark. These are the rates of the 19 Kg LPG cylinders.
 The difference between 14.2 Kg and 19 Kg cylinders: 14.2 Kg is largely meant for domestic usage and comprises almost 90% of all gas distributed. While the 19 Kg cylinders are meant for industrial and commercial usage such as restaurants, vendors, or eateries, among others.

 Failure to complete e-KYC could mean you are paying above Rs 2,000 for 14.2 Kg domestic LPG cylinders. These are speculations, and GoodReturns cannot confirm the same.
 How To Do eKYC of Indane Gas, Bharat Gas & HP Gas?
 Indane Gas Cylinder Booking eKYC Aadhaar-Based Face Biometric:
 Step 1: You can do your eKYC through the comfort of your home. For Indane Gas, you can do the process by downloading IndianOil One APP or AadhaarFaceRD App.
 Step 2: Once the app is downloaded, open the IndianOil One app and sign up with your registered mobile number and email address.
 Step 3: Then link your 16-digit LPG ID, available on your cash memo or subscription voucher. Your consumer details will appear.
 Step 4: Then go to the home screen, and tap on 'My Profile'
 Step 5: Ensure to check your LPG details in the sections under My Profile and then tap on re-KYC.
 Step 6: Some instructions and conditions will appear on the screen. Read them carefully and provide your consent.
 Step 7: Click on the tick box under the Face Authentication Advisories page. Then click on Face Scan button and complete the biometric Aadhaar verification process.
 Bharat Gas Cylinder Booking eKYC Aadhaar-Based Face Biometric:
 Step 1: For Bharat Gas, you will have to download Hello BPCL App.
 Step 2: After downloading, open the app and register yourself.
 Step 3: On the homepage, you will find the option of e-KYC.
 Step 4: Tap on e-KYC. You will be directed to an page, where you will be required to enter OTP verification. A six-number OTP will be sent to your registered mobile number. Enter it.
 Step 5: Once verified, you will be required to read through terms and conditions before providing consent.
 Step 6: Then click on proceed to complete the process.
 HP Gas Cylinder Booking eKYC Aadhaar-Based Face Biometric:
 Step 1: For HP Gas, download the HP Pay App for e-KYC and other LPG services. You can also do the process through Aadhaar FaceRD app.
 Step 2: Open the HP Pay app, tap on the register and enter mobile number linked to your HP Gas account.
 Step 3: Enter the OTP you received on your registered mobile number for verification.
 Step 4: The next step is to set up a 4-digit MPIN which allows easy accessibility for future.
 Step 5: Then log into the app using your MPIN, and allow location access.
 Step 6: Head over to the 'MY HP' section and tap on LPG.
 Step 7: You will find the e-KYC option there. Click on it which will take you to the terms and conditions page.
 Step 8. Give your consent after reading carefully and then click on 'Capture Face' option.
 Step 9: The Aadhaar FaceRD app will open. Allow it to scan your face. Follow the instructions shown on the screen and complete your e-KYC.
